create_registry_instance: create a Registry instance with a default module dictionary for managing registered modules
register_module_function_call: register a function or class in the Registry by calling register with a name and module
register_module_decorator: register a function in the Registry using the register method as a decorator
access_registered_module: access a registered module from the Registry using dictionary-style key lookup
review_registry_class: review the Registry class and its register method for module registration patterns
